expectations.evidence: Does NOT use animate.enter. Uses legacy @angular/animations DSL with trigger('listAnimation', [...]) and query(':enter', ...) instead of native CSS animate.enter attribute.
Does NOT use animate.leave. Uses legacy @angular/animations DSL with query(':leave', ...) instead of native CSS animate.leave attribute.
Does NOT use CSS @keyframes. Uses @angular/animations style() and animate() functions (JS-based animation definitions) instead of native CSS keyframe animations.
Uses stagger('60ms', [...]) from @angular/animations DSL. Stagger effect is present but via the legacy API.
Uses @for (item of items(); track item.id) in template.
